text:
Maya: Heads-up — I filed a small docs PR to harmonize the SDK examples after we renamed a few streaming/pagination helpers. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512

Ethan: Nice. What changed exactly?

Maya: TL;DR: the async streaming helper is now client.stream (was stream_iter), pagers expose an opaque page_token (not cursor), and retries are surfaced via max_retries with jittered exponential backoff. PR touches examples/python/stream.md, examples/typescript/pager.md, examples/go/listing.md.

Priya: Reviewer checklist I added in the PR description:
- Python shows resumable usage with a resume_token example
- TS uses for-await-of + corrected internal link to SDK streaming guide
- Go demonstrates pager.Next(), pager.Value(), and how to pass PageToken back into ListOptions
- Add a one-liner documenting default max_retries=3 and when to lower for low-latency paths

Jonah: Quick sanity check on the Python snippet you dropped in the PR:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")

async def run():
    async for chunk in client.stream("gpt-small", prompt="tl;dr this", max_retries=2):
        print(chunk.text, end="")
```
Looks fine — note we should recommend callers catch CancelledError when they time out.

Ethan: TS snippet I updated to fix an anchor and show resumable token pattern:
```ts
for await (const part of client.stream('gpt-small', { prompt: 'tl;dr' })) {
  process.stdout.write(part.text)
}
// resume: client.stream('gpt-small', { resume_token: lastToken })
```

Priya: Go example I proposed:
```go
pager := client.ListResponses(ctx, &ListOpts{PageSize: 100})
for pager.Next() {
  r := pager.Value()
  // handle r
}
if err := pager.Err(); err != nil {
  // handle
}
// Resume: opts.PageToken = pager.PageToken()
```

docs-bot: CI for PR 512 — checks: pass. Auto-linker replaced stale anchor in examples/typescript/pager.md. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Can @Ethan add a brief note in PR about backoff behavior (base, max, jitter)? And @Priya add the resume example inline in the Go doc?

Ethan: Added a 2-line runbook note about exponential_backoff defaults and suggesting max_retries=1 for latency-sensitive routes.

Priya: Added resume snippet and clarifying text about page_token being opaque — do not parse.

Maya: Sweet. Approving once docs-bot CI is still green; will merge and backport to archived-guides branch.

Jonah: LGTM.

Ethan: Approving.

Maya: Merging in 10m if no objections. Thanks!
